title: A small hex dump
summary: Show a file as hexadecimal bytes, 16 per line, reading it with read in blocks.
hints: Read into an `unsigned char buf[16]` with a loop that keeps calling `read(fd, buf + n, 16 - n)` until the block is full or `read` returns 0 (a read can return fewer bytes than asked).
`printf("%08lx:", offset)` for the line start and `printf(" %02x", buf[i])` for each byte (it is `unsigned`, so it never prints `ffffff..`).
